newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel denies issuing arrest warrant for Murdoch.
newsitem.headline: Israel denies issuing arrest warrant for Murdoch.

text.p: Israel's Income Tax Authority on Sunday denied a report in London's Sunday Business newspaper that a warrant had been issued for the arrest of media magnate Rupert Murdoch in connection with an investigation of tax fraud.

"This is completely untrue. No arrest warrant has been issued," a spokeswoman for the tax authority told Reuters. A lawyer for Murdoch's News Datacom Research Ltd in Israel also denied that an arrest warrant had been issued.
The tax authority spokeswoman said the authority would issue a formal denial to the newspaper article later on Sunday.

But she said that the document accompanying the article, which the newspaper said was a copy of the arrest warrant, was actually an order to hand over documents connected with the tax investigation. The order, known as a disclosure warrant, was issued on October 17, three days before the tax authority raided the offices of Murdoch's Israeli subsidiary.

News Datacom Research, which develops encryption systems for pay television, has become the subject of an investigation by the Israeli tax authority on suspicions it concealed up to $150 million in income over several years.
Murdoch has denied the charges and promised to cooperate with investigators. News Datacom Research is controlled by Murdoch's News Corp.
